privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: Welcome to our website at https://minecraftsgame.com/. We are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Policy ("Policy") explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information, and describes your rights over your personal data. Please read it carefully.
By using our services or visiting our website, you agree to the practices described in this Policy. If you disagree with any part of it, please refrain from using our services or website.

sections.heading: Data Controller
paragraphs: As data controller under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), we determine the purposes and means of processing your personal data and are responsible for compliance with applicable data protection law.

sections.heading: Information We Gather
paragraphs: Depending on how you use our services, we may collect and process the following categories of personal data:
bullets: Account Information: login credentials, username, activity logs, settings, and profile details.
Contact Details: your email address and, where provided, phone number or postal address.
Transaction Information: your order and purchase history and account balance.

Payment Data: Payments are handled by our authorised payment processor, FINTECH GLOBAL SOFTWARE LTD. We do not collect, process, or store your payment card details or other sensitive financial information. Payment data is collected and processed directly by the payment gateway in compliance with PCI-DSS standards.
Communication Records: correspondence with our customer support team.
Technical Information: device data, IP address, operating system, browser type, and settings.
Customer Support Data: details of issues you report and how they were resolved.
Marketing Preferences: your preferences regarding marketing communications, where applicable.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use personal data for the following purposes, each supported by an appropriate legal basis:
bullets: Service Provision — to provide the Services you request (Legal Basis: contractual necessity).
Account Management — to create and manage your account (Legal Basis: contractual necessity).
Order Fulfilment — to process and deliver your purchases (Legal Basis: contractual necessity).
Transaction Management — to execute and manage payments securely (Legal Basis: contractual necessity, legitimate interests).
Customer Support — to respond to inquiries and provide assistance (Legal Basis: contractual necessity, legitimate interests).
Legal Compliance — to meet applicable legal and regulatory obligations (Legal Basis: legal obligation).
Fraud Prevention — to detect and prevent misuse of our services (Legal Basis: legal obligation, legitimate interests).
Service Improvement — to improve and develop our website and services (Legal Basis: legitimate interests).
Marketing — to send marketing communications, where you have consented (Legal Basis: consent).

sections.heading: Mandatory and Optional Information
paragraphs: Some information is required for us to provide our services and will be identified as such at the point of collection; without it, we may be unable to provide certain Services. Other information is optional and helps us personalize your experience.

sections.heading: How We Collect Data
paragraphs: We collect personal data through the following methods:
bullets: Direct Interactions: information you provide directly, e.g. when creating an account, making a purchase, or contacting support.
Automated Technologies: data collected via cookies and similar technologies as you use our website — see our Cookie Policy for details.
Third-Party Sources: information we may receive from service partners, such as our payment providers.

sections.heading: Data Sharing
paragraphs: We may share your personal data with trusted service providers who assist us with payment processing, analytics, or customer support, and who are bound by appropriate data protection obligations; regulatory authorities or governmental bodies, where required to comply with a legal obligation; and other recipients, where you have given us your consent or instructed us to do so.
We do not sell your personal data.

sections.heading: Data Security
paragraphs: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data, including encryption in transit and at rest, access controls, and regular security reviews. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we encourage you to use a strong, unique password and enable two-factor authentication where available.

sections.heading: International Data Transfers
paragraphs: Where it is necessary to transfer your personal data outside the European Economic Area (EEA), we rely on appropriate safeguards, such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses, to ensure your data continues to receive an equivalent level of protection.

sections.heading: Your Data Rights
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:
bullets: Access — obtain a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Correction — request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Deletion — request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten"), subject to legal or legitimate grounds for retention.
Restriction — request that we limit processing in certain circumstances.
Objection — object to processing based on our legitimate interests or for direct marketing.
Portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
Withdraw Consent — withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent, without affecting past lawful processing.

sections.heading: Automated Decision-Making
paragraphs: We do not make decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects on you based solely on automated processing, without human involvement.

sections.heading: Data of Minors
paragraphs: Our services are not intended for individuals under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors, and we will delete any such data promptly if we become aware of it. If you believe a minor has provided us with personal data, please contact us.

sections.heading: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this Policy, or as required by applicable law, generally aligned with the limitation period for potential claims. Once retention is no longer necessary, we securely delete or anonymize the data.

sections.heading: Complaints
paragraphs: If you have concerns about how we handle your personal data, please contact us first. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the data protection authority in your country of residence.

sections.heading: Updates to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of significant changes through the website or by email. Continued use of our services after such changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.

sections.heading: Contact Information
paragraphs: For any questions about this Policy, please contact us at privacy@minecraftsgame.com.

sections.heading: Our Services
paragraphs: The Website is a Minecraft shop operated by the Company. We operate dedicated Servers within the Game, on which users can play. Through your personal account (the "Personal Cabinet") on the Website, you may purchase privileges and crystals and other Digital Items. When you complete a purchase, you select the Server on which you wish to play, and the purchased Digital Item is delivered to your account on that Server.

sections.heading: Server Access
paragraphs: Access to our Servers is free of charge. To connect, you will need a licensed copy of the Game. After launching the Game, enter the relevant Server's IP address in the multiplayer menu. Server IP addresses are available on the Website. If you wish to play on a different one of our Servers, you may return to the Website to obtain the corresponding IP address.

sections.heading: User Account Registration
paragraphs: To access certain Services or areas of the Website, you must register an account (the "Account") and provide details such as your name, country of residence, password, and email address.

You represent and warrant that all information you provide is current, complete, and accurate, and you agree to keep it up to date, including your email address and payment details, so that we can process transactions and contact you when necessary. Information you provide during registration will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Keep your password confidential.

Your Account is linked to your personal email address, and you may not allow third parties to access it. You are responsible for safeguarding your Account credentials and for all activity carried out under your Account.

We may decline a registration for valid and objective reasons, including a violation of these Terms, fraud-prevention measures, doubts about your identity, suspected spam activity, uncertainty about your age, fraudulent behaviour, or an attempt to register from a jurisdiction where our Services are unavailable.

sections.heading: User Account Policy
paragraphs: You are solely responsible for all activity that occurs under your Account. You agree not to use another user's account, username, or password, and not to disclose your own password to any third party.
You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your Account.

If we have reasonable grounds to suspect a violation of these Terms, or that information you provided is untrue, inaccurate, or incomplete, we may terminate your Account and refuse further access to some or all Services.
We are not responsible for any loss or damage arising from unauthorized access to or use of your Account.

sections.heading: Inactive User Account Policy
paragraphs: We may disable or deactivate Accounts that remain inactive for more than 30 calendar days, and associated data may be deleted as a result. We are not obliged to give you prior notice of such action.

sections.heading: In-Game Purchases
paragraphs: To purchase Digital Items from our in-game shop, you first need access to one of our Servers as described above.
To purchase a Digital Item, select the item you require in your Personal Cabinet, choose the Server to which it should be delivered, and pay using an accepted payment method.
We will make purchased Digital Items available on your account, on the selected Server, without undue delay once we receive confirmation of your payment.
We are not obliged to complete a purchase where a payment attempt is unsuccessful or is rejected by our payment service provider.

Purchases must be made from your own account only. We reserve the right to refuse any order, and to limit or cancel quantities purchased per person, household, or order, including orders placed using the same account, payment card, or billing details. If we change or cancel an order, we will attempt to notify you using the contact details on file. We may limit or refuse orders that, in our judgement, appear to be placed by resellers or distributors.
You agree to keep your account and payment information current, complete, and accurate so that we can process your purchases and contact you as needed.

sections.heading: Prices
paragraphs: Prices generally include any applicable delivery, handling, and taxes; if they do not, we will inform you before you place your order. Your purchase may be subject to foreign exchange fees or price differences based on your location.
We may adjust, suspend, or discontinue any Service at our discretion and are not responsible for losses arising from such changes.

To the extent permitted by law, we may change our prices at any time. We will give you reasonable notice of any pricing change by posting updated prices on the Website and/or notifying you by email or other prominent means.

If you do not wish to pay a new price, you may cancel the relevant subscription before the change takes effect. To avoid being charged, you must actively cancel your subscription at least 24 hours before the current billing period ends.

sections.heading: Payments
paragraphs: Payments may be charged to your account using a debit or credit card or another accepted payment method.
Purchases must be paid for in advance. You can only buy a Digital Item or Service if you have sufficient funds or credit available.
If a payment is not approved, or is returned for insufficient funds, your order will not be processed.
All payments are processed by our third-party payment service providers. The Website is notified once a payment is completed and does not store payment card details.
Where applicable, we comply with relevant EU payment services legislation, including Directive (EU) 2015/2366 (PSD2).

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Dexervil LTD ("we," "us," or "the Company") uses cookies and similar technologies on https://minecraftsgame.com/ (the "Website"). It should be read together with our Privacy Policy, which explains how we use personal data more generally.

sections.heading: What Are Cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They allow the website to recognize your device and store information about your preferences or past actions. We also use similar technologies, such as local storage and pixels, which are covered by this Policy along with cookies.

sections.heading: Types of Cookies We Use
paragraphs: We use the following categories of cookies:
bullets: Strictly Necessary Cookies — required for the Website to function, such as keeping you logged into your account and enabling secure checkout. These cannot be switched off in our systems.
Functional Cookies — remember your preferences, such as your selected Server or language, to improve your experience.
Analytics Cookies — help us understand how visitors interact with the Website (e.g. via Google Analytics), so we can improve its performance and content.
Marketing Cookies — used, where applicable and with your consent, to deliver more relevant advertising and measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns.

sections.heading: Third-Party Cookies
paragraphs: Some cookies are placed by third-party service providers who provide functionality on our Website, such as analytics or payment processing. These third parties may use cookies in accordance with their own privacy and cookie policies, over which we do not have full control.

sections.heading: How Long Do Cookies Last?
paragraphs: Cookies may be session-based or persistent:
bullets: Session Cookies — temporary and deleted once you close your browser.
Persistent Cookies — remain on your device for a set period, or until you delete them manually, so that the Website remembers your preferences across visits.

sections.heading: Managing Your Cookie Preferences
paragraphs: When you first visit the Website, you will be asked to consent to non-essential cookies via our cookie banner. You can change your preferences at any time.

You can also manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies, delete existing cookies, or be notified before a cookie is stored. Please note that blocking strictly necessary cookies may affect the functionality of the Website, including your ability to log in or complete a purchase.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in the cookies we use or for legal or regulatory reasons. We encourage you to review this Policy periodically.

sections.heading: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have any questions about this Cookie Policy, please contact us at privacy@minecraftsgame.com.

delivery.title: Delivery Policy
delivery.intro: This Delivery Policy explains how Adventures in Minecraft delivers digital items, privileges, and in-game currency after you complete a purchase on our website.

sections.heading: Digital Delivery
paragraphs: All products sold through our store are digital goods delivered directly to your in-game account. There is no physical shipping involved.
Delivery is initiated automatically after your payment is confirmed by our payment provider.

sections.heading: Server and Nickname
paragraphs: At checkout you must select the target game server and provide the in-game nickname that should receive the items.
You are responsible for entering the correct server and nickname. We cannot redirect items that were delivered to a nickname you entered incorrectly.

sections.heading: Online Requirement
paragraphs: You must be online on the selected server at the moment of purchase for delivery to succeed.
If you are offline when payment completes, delivery may be delayed or fail. Join the selected server as soon as possible after paying so your items can be credited.

sections.heading: Delivery Timeframes
paragraphs: Most purchases are delivered within seconds of payment confirmation. In rare cases — such as server maintenance or high load — delivery may take up to 24 hours.
If you have not received your items within 24 hours, please contact our support team with your order details.

sections.heading: Failed or Partial Delivery
paragraphs: If delivery fails due to a technical issue on our side, we will retry automatically or manually credit your account once the issue is resolved.
If delivery fails because you were offline, used an incorrect nickname, or selected the wrong server, you must contact support. We will review the case and attempt to resolve it where possible.

sections.heading: Contact Support
paragraphs: For any delivery-related questions or issues, reach out to us via Discord or the contact channels listed on our Contacts page. Include your in-game nickname, server, and approximate purchase time.
